fixtures.preview: Pochettino's second game in charge comes three days after a 4-0 defeat at Anfield; kick-off is 7am Thursday 26 Nov in Sydney.
talking_points: Leny Yoro's eighth-minute red card at Anfield was overturned and his one-match suspension removed, per Sky Sports, though United still dispute the refereeing chief's backing of the original call.
Pochettino blamed VAR after the 4-0 loss, asking 'what were they doing?' over the red card and Szoboszlai's free-kick goal.
United were 17th in the Champions League league phase after beating Roma 3-2 on matchday 4; Sporting were 10th, per Paramount+'s matchday guide.
Line-ups and injuries for Lisbon haven't been confirmed in anything I could open, so treat team news as pending.

fixtures.preview: Expected to be Pochettino's first home game in charge, 3pm UK time Saturday 28 Nov (2am Sunday in Sydney).
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at 8pm UK time (7am Thursday in Sydney); Sky notes fixtures are subject to change.
A Saturday 3pm home game (2am Sunday in Sydney), the second of three league games in eight days.
A Saturday 3pm trip to south London (2am Sunday in Sydney), per Sky's schedule.
The first men's Big Blue of the season, after a weekend off for Sydney.
talking_points: Sydney drew 0-0 away to Brisbane Roar and sit third on the ladder after five rounds, with four points from their last two games.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo called his side 'a bit sloppy' before half-time but praised their second-half reaction.
Jacob Farrell made his debut after a long injury layoff, and injuries and thin depth have forced several young players into debuts.
Oriola Sunday came closest to a late winner against Brisbane.

fixtures.preview: A Grand Final rematch in Auckland at 5pm NZ time (3pm Sydney), Matchweek 8.
Saturday 2 Jan home game; the club's fixture article gives the date but I couldn't find a kick-off time.

notes: Many sites (BBC, the Guardian, manutd.com, ESPN, supermarket and Rebel pages) were blocked, so Man Utd team news rests on Sky Sports and a Paramount+ matchday guide. No line-ups or injury news for Sporting were found; Yoro's suspension was removed, per Sky.

Correction: the 20 Dec Sydney FC v Central Coast Mariners game at WIN Stadium, Wollongong, is on the club's women's fixture list, not the men's, so it has been removed from the men's fixtures and live sport.

Sydney FC men's fixtures: only the dates I could find are listed. The 28 Dec Macarthur and 2 Jan Brisbane Roar home games are confirmed, but away games before 2 Jan weren't found and may fall in between. The 2 Jan kick-off time isn't published, so 12:00 is a placeholder. Paramount+ as A-League broadcaster was not re-confirmed per match.

Big matches: Champions League and Premier League on Stan Sport and the Nations Championship on Stan Sport follow search results on Stan's rights; I couldn't open Stan's own listings. Tuesday's UCL games (Arsenal, Man City, Real Madrid) have already been played and were dropped.

Live sport: no Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas/Socceroos home games were found in the next four weeks. Sydney Kings v Perth is listed with 5pm from third-party listings, as I couldn't open an official page with the time.

Local: school dates come from the Term 4 calendar and the Week 6 Principal Update and may change. Nothing was found for the second school. No dated local news from the last week beyond Rosina's was found; Tenjo's Redfern rooftop opening (16 Nov) is older than 7 days.

Groceries: Woolworths and Coles catalogues for 25 Nov–1 Dec come from an OzBargain half-price roundup, as supermarket sites were blocked. No Aldi prices were found, and no half-price fresh fruit, veg, eggs, nuts or matcha appeared in the roundup.

Deals: Rebel's and Puma's Black Friday pages were blocked, so no football-boot discounts are listed; Black Friday is Fri 27 Nov and more should appear. Many links go to OzBargain posts, so check the retailer before buying. The earlier Coles $10 click-and-collect deal now shows as expired and was removed.

Son and daughter: no junior parkrun, Roblox or children's author event was confirmed. Noa Matcha's listing gives conflicting start dates (7 Nov or 5 Dec), so check the booking page. The 5K Foam Fest (5 Dec, Horsley Park) was left out as it isn't easily reached by train.

Arts: ticket prices weren't confirmed for several Opera House and Frontier shows, and the Sydney Theatre Company page for Whispering Jack was blocked. Boyz II Men (4 Dec) is sold out and was left out.
Horizon: Pitbull is new. Items marked 'Not re-checked this run' keep last run's details.
